questions.q: Why are video games so popular, according to the summary?
a: They create social bonds and a sense of accomplishment
They offer a permanent escape from reality
They require no skill or effort to enjoy
They cost less than every other hobby
questions.why: Lesson 1 says games meet our need to connect and to feel excited and accomplished.

questions.q: What does the summary say games give players that daily life often lacks?
a: Clear rewards and a sense of hope
A break from all social contact
A guarantee of financial success
Relief from any physical effort
questions.why: Lesson 1 says missions and rewards add excitement and optimism that reality rarely provides.

questions.q: What did Jane use to make housework more engaging?
a: A game called Chore Wars
A timer and a reward chart
A shared cleaning schedule
A weekly family contest
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes Chore Wars, where points for chores made cleaning competitive.

questions.q: What skill does the summary call the most prominent among long-time gamers?
a: Collaboration
Hand-eye coordination
Memorization
Patience
questions.why: Lesson 3 says many games require teams to communicate, set rules and coordinate.

questions.q: What does the 10,000 hour rule suggest about gamers?
a: They likely build valuable skills through long practice
They waste time that could go to school
They peak in skill before adulthood
They need fewer hours to master a game
questions.why: Lesson 3 links the average 10,000 hours of play to world-class practice and transferable skills.
